fields.why: HIV-related death rates are reported for four race/ethnicity groups with differences and ratios vs White, and for five age groups and three gender groups.
The gender variable includes transgender categories, so it is SOGI. Leaving out the transmission category (an exposure route) and the regions and jurisdictions (geography) is right.
Race is assessed only by rate differences and ratios against White (per-group vs referent). Age and gender rates are set side by side with no CIs or tests.
